Organized By Learnix Labs × Zevik A collaborative initiative bringing together Learnix Labs and Zevik to provide participants with a competitive platform to demonstrate their coding and problem-solving abilities.

raw.details:
Overview

TechArena 2026 is an online coding challenge co-organized by Learnix Labs and Zevik, designed to assess programming skills, problem-solving ability, algorithms, data structures, and logical thinking through a structured competitive coding assessment.

Format

  • Online coding contest
  • 5 programming problems
  • Progressive difficulty: Easy to Hard
  • Total: 1000 marks
  • Assessment duration: 90 minutes
  • Individual participation
  • Multiple programming languages supported
  • Skills Assessed

Programming, Problem Solving, Data Structures, Algorithms, Logical Thinking, and Competitive Coding.

Rules

  • Participants must complete the assessment within the allotted 90-minute duration once started.
  • Each problem carries different marks based on its difficulty.
  • Participants may attempt the questions in any order.
  • Solutions must pass the provided test cases to receive marks.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring a stable internet connection during the assessment.
  • Any form of unfair means or plagiarism may result in disqualification.
  • The final score will be determined by the marks obtained in the assessment.

Eligibility

Open to students and coding enthusiasts interested in testing and improving their programming and problem-solving skills.

Participation

Register through Unstop and participate in the coding assessment during the scheduled contest window.

Top 10 Exclusive Benefit

The Top 10 performers will receive a free .xyz domain for the first year, worth $15, along with the recognition and certificates mentioned in the Rewards and Prizes section.

Organized By Learnix Labs × Zevik

A collaborative initiative bringing together Learnix Labs and Zevik to provide participants with a competitive platform to demonstrate their coding and problem-solving abilities.

prizes.others: National Winner Certificate, featured on Learnix Labs official social media platforms, and priority consideration for future Learnix Labs opportunities.
Excellence Certificate and featured on Learnix Labs official social media platforms.
Merit Certificate and mention on Learnix Labs official social media platforms.
Free .xyz domain for the first year, worth $15, Top Performer Badge, and recognition on Learnix Labs official social media platforms.
